source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Delete confirmation belongs at front-end command call sites, which know the selected view and folder. The May 2024 move fixed missing Shift+Delete warnings for unified folders, conversation view, and Search Messages. Do not rely on nsMsgDBView to choose the prompt for every UI surface.
title: Ask for destructive delete confirmation at the UI call site
